To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have designed and implemented a distributed disk-based scalable graph-processing framework, DD-Graph, and have evaluated its performance and scalability.
DD-Graph is a highly cost-effective distributed disk-based graphprocessing framework.

1) DD-Graph can handle graphs with hundreds of billions of edges on a small cluster of commodity compute nodes with the performance that is comparable to that of in-memory graph-processing systems; 2) DD-Graph is highly cost-effective as it can be implemented on commodity computers that are affordable to most organizations; and 3) DD-Graph provides a high-level API to simplify the programming of graph algorithms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of DD-Graph, which is a distributed disk-based framework for processing super-large graphs, and the evaluation of the framework on both synthetic and real graphs.
the following three questions: 1) How to design a distributed disk-based framework to handle large-scale graphs?

the following two problems: 1) how to design and implement a distributed disk-based framework that is highly cost effective, and 2) how to achieve high performance in the use of a small cluster for super-large graphs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DD-Graph is a distributed disk-based framework for graph processing that is capable of scaling out on commodity compute nodes and achieving high performance.
this paper presents DD-Graph, a distributed disk-based framework for graph-processing.

DD-Graph can handle graphs of billions of edges and vertices with billions of edges on a cluster of 10 commodity machines, while existing in-memory graph-processing systems, such as GPS, Pregel, Giraph, and PowerGraph, are not capable of handling graphs beyond a few hundred million edges on such a cluster.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DD-Graph is the first distributed disk-based graphprocessing framework that can scale out to thousands of compute machines, while achieving high performance.
DD-Graph is a cost-effective framework to support large-scale graph-processing tasks on small clusters.
, we propose a novel distributed disk-based graph processing framework that can scale out and achieve high performance by using a small cluster.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of the high performance of in-memory graph-processing and the cost effectiveness of disk-based graph-processing can be achieved in a single system.
the combination of distributed processing and disk-based storage is a highly cost-effective solution to processing very large graphs.
a small cluster can be a cost-effective solution to process super-large graphs.
